parse.title: Summon
parse.text:
Summon is an area in the lobby where players can obtain powerful characters to aid them in the completion of Levels. It is located to the left of the Leaderboard area. Please note that not every MythicalMythical can be viably used in later stages. If you've saved up gems, it's suggested to find a video showcasing of a unit before attempting to spin for it on the unit banner.

Legacy Banner

Each summon will cost you 50 Gems Gems (40 Gems Gems with the VIP Gamepass) or a Summon Ticket. Every hour the banner will be refreshed with random units, with 3 MythicalMythical units being featured.

(Legacy gems are required for this banner, which can be obtained by either converting regular gems, or by disenchanting certain units.)

The summoning rates for this banner are similar to the Special Banner, however each individual unfeatured MythicalMythical will have a SLIGHTLY higher chance to be summoned (0.714% vs 0.625% out of the 0.5% mythic chance), due to the units from Update 19 and onwards not being present in this banner.

Summoning builds up Pity bar for middle unit; with each summon, you will accumulate 1/400 in pity bar for MythicalMythical Pity. Accumulating 400 pulls will grant you a guaranteed MythicalMythical featured middle unit.

Pulling a MythicalMythical character at any point whilst summoning will reset the corresponding Pity back to 0. Pity will also reset once the banner has refreshed.

Special Banner

Since Update 7, The Special Banner can summon any unit in the game, excluding those obtainable through other means, and other banners. The chances of getting a MythicalMythical unit are 0.5%. As opposed to the Legacy Banner, units from Update 19 and onwards are obtainable from this banner.

Three Mythics will be featured. The center MythicalMythical has a 50% chance of being the summoned MythicalMythical. The Mythics beside it have a 10% chance, and any unfeatured MythicalMythical has a 0.526% chance. Just like the standard banner, the featured Mythics are refreshed every hour.

Since Update 17, all MythicalMythical units from Release to Update 6.5 have been removed from the Special Banner. As of Update 19, however, they have been added back to this banner.

Like Legacy Banner, there is also a pity for middle featured unit to guarantee summoned after 400 pulls, which cost total of 20,000 Gems20,000 Gems ( 16,000 Gems16,000 Gems if owned VIP gamepass)

Event Banner

Since Update 13.5, limited-time MythicalMythical units can be summoned from the Event Banner. The chance to obtain a Mythic is 0.5%, similar to the special banner. However, only 3 limited-time MythicalMythical units are featured, with no other MythicalMythical units being obtainable from this banner. Units on the Event Banner can only be summoned using a limited-time currency, typically obtained from the current event.

The MythicalMythical units featured are constant, and the banner does not refresh every hour; the featured units stay from the beginning to the end of the event. They will instead be replaced by new event MythicalMythical units from future events. MythicalMythical Pity can be achieved by summoning 200 times. Unowned MythicalMythical units are prioritized by the Pity, until all featured Mythics are obtained. It costs a total of 2000 event currency to get the MythicalMythical Pity for the current event.


Legendary pity is not included in this banner.

Summon Chance

Every single unit has the same chance of being obtained from a Summon according to their Rarity. Below are the chances for each Rarity:

  • Rare = 81.9% / Shiny Rare: 0.819% chance of dropping (2.457% with shiny hunter).
  • Epic = 16% / Shiny Epic: 0.16% chance of dropping (0.48% with shiny hunter).
  • Legendary = 2% / Shiny Legendary: 0.02% chance of dropping (0.06% with shiny hunter).
  • MythicalMythical = 0.25% / Shiny MythicalMythical: 0.0025% chance of dropping (0.0075% with shiny hunter).
    • MythicalMythical from the Special Banner = 0.5% / Shiny MythicalMythical: 0.005% chance of dropping (0.015% with shiny hunter).
    • MythicalMythical from the Event Banner = 0.5% / Shiny MythicalMythical: 0.005% chance of dropping (0.015% with shiny hunter). (Same as special.)
  • Secret = 1/400,000 chance / Shiny Secret = ??? (estimated to be around 0.005% chance for non-shinies)
  • All summoned unit has 1% chance to be Shiny version (3% if obtained Shiny Hunter gamepass)

Secret (Normal and Shiny) and Shiny MythicalMythical units are known to be very rare. Whenever somebody summons one in any server, it is announced in the Roblox chat globally.

Consuming a Luck Potion will increase the odds of obtaining an Epic, Legendary, or MythicalMythical, but will NOT reduce the pity.

In the banner window, extra potent luck potions can be purchased for Robux. These potions increase the odds of obtaining Legendary and MythicalMythical summons. The Super Lucky potion costs 99 Robux and increases odds for said rarities by 2x. The Ultra Lucky potion costs 149 Robux and increases odds for said rarities by 3x.

These buffs DO stack and using a Luck, Super Lucky, and Ultra Lucky all at once, will set the MythicalMythical chance to 0.936%.

Luck Potion does not shows to affect on Event Banner.

Banner Tiers

Banner Tiers are a mechanic released in Update 1.5 to make it so that newer players aren't able to roll for certain types of units. This is to make sure late-game players can't make alt accounts to pull better and stronger Units.

  • Tier 0 (Player Level 0+): Can't summon Secret units or shinies.
  • Tier 1 (Player Level 5+): Can summon shinies but not Secret units.
  • Tier 2 (Player Level 20+): Can summon Secret units and shinies.

Trivia

  • Since the Halloween 2022 update, if anyone pulls a Shiny MythicalMythical or a Secret, it announces it in chat for everyone playing to see.
  • Since update 20.4.1, secret chance has been revealed to be 1/400,000 chance, however it does not have a pity.
    • Along with all banner has been added pity chance for middle unit after 200 times summon.
    • Legendary pity has also been removed, replace with MythicalMythical pity with 400 pulls.
